expected_findings.note: Concurrent read-then-debit: every request reads the balance before any debit lands, so a batch whose total exceeds the balance is fully approved and the account overdraws. Sequential order was load-bearing.

risk_checks.title: Withdrawals in a batch now run concurrently
risk_checks.detail: Every request in the batch reads the balance and debits the same account in parallel.

risk_checks.title: Batch results may come back out of request order
risk_checks.detail: Requests now resolve concurrently; callers match each result to its request by position.
